## 任务：Binary classification 模型训练 + DD OOD 评估 (seed=123)

- 服务器: westd-33183
- 项目路径: /root/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/
- Python: source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate
- GPU: cuda:0

查看现有训练脚本和 binary 模型的训练配置：
```bash
ls /root/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/checkpoints/plan_013_binary/

```bash

  --seed 123 \
  --output_file results/mf1_binary_seed123_dd_ood.json

{

  "seed": 123,

  "deberta": {"val_persuasion_acc": ..., "val_intent_acc": ..., "best_epoch": ...}
}
```
